newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee untraded on lack of demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee untraded on lack of demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee was untraded nearly two hours after the market opened due to a lack of early import covering demand, dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at 57.30 to the dollar at 0500 GMT, after opening at 57.28. The currency closed at 57.26 on Friday.

"There has been no early import covering demand. It is doubtful whether there will be any demand even later in the day, because it is a working day sandwiched between holidays," said an American Express Bank dealer.

The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by 4.25 local cents, in response to the greenback's overseas gains against the mark and sterling, dealers said. Buying and selling prices were fixed at 56.2543 and 57.3907.
Overnight call money was at 12.5 percent, after opening at 13 percent, dealers said.
